notes.title: A Little Perspective - new game from the designer of HueBots
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been almost 10 years since HueBots came out - but I'm still out here making games! In fact, today I just launched the store page + trailer of a new puzzle game called A Little Perspective.

It's a game about epiphany, full of surprising moments, challenging puzzles, and even some secrets. tl;dr It's another game that I can't share too much of without spoiling it!

If you're interested in this kind of game, check out the trailer, give it a wishlist, and look out for a demo in the coming months :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3485300/A_Little_Perspective/

notes.title: Sensorium, new game from the designer of HueBots, is out now!
notes.content:
Hello HueBots fans,

A few months after the release of HueBots in 2015, I started working on a new game called "Sensorium". After 4.5 years in development, it's finally being released.

Sensorium is a first-person puzzle game that revolves around the 5 senses: touch, taste, smell, sight, and hearing. The game takes place in a small open world shrouded in mystery. In the game you must explore, learn, and solve puzzles to find your way home.

Sensorium has been a side project of mine for a long time, and I'm really excited for it to finally be finished!

You can get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307870/Sensorium/
